  let seededCount = 0;
  for (const exercise of masterExercises) {
    try {
      await prisma.exercise.upsert({
        where: { name: exercise.name },
        update: {},
        create: exercise,
      });
      seededCount++;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`Failed to seed ${exercise.name}:`, err);

  }

  console.log(`Successfully populated ${seededCount} exercises.`);

  process.exit(1);
} finally {
